name: Broken Sword II: The Smoking Mirror
aliases: Broken Sword II: The Smoking Mirror - Remastered

locations.note: George and Nico's look into a mysterious Mayan stone at Professor Oubier's house ends in an ambush and Nico's kidnapping; the Glease Gallery and the café are here too.
George traces Nico to the Condor Transglobal warehouse in the Marseille docks and gets her out.
Quaramonte City, the jungle river, the shaman's village and the Mayan pyramid where the three stones must be brought together.
George sails to Ketch's Landing and the island where the Spanish pirate who stole the second stone made his home; Nico joins him there.
Nico tracks the third stone, taken by an English pirate, from the British Museum to the Underground and the docks.
Nico finds the jaguar stone has already been stolen from the museum.

routes.name: George
routes.note: Paris, the Marseille warehouse, Quaramonte, then the Caribbean island for the pirate's stone and back to the pyramid.

routes.name: Nico
routes.note: After Quaramonte Nico hunts the third stone in London, meets George on Zombie Island, and the two return to the pyramid together.
